caveats: Profiles come from TRAIN only and are applied to test, so this is inductive - aggregating over the whole capture would be transductive, the defect already disclosed for rank fusion.
Attacker identity is deliberately NOT used. CIC-IDS2017 documents the attacker subnet and conditioning on it would be label leakage dressed as domain knowledge (Arp et al. P4).
The unknown-host fraction bounds what host-role knowledge can do at deployment: those flows get no profile signal at all.
Exogeneity is tested with gradient boosting on the 68 features; a stronger predictor might recover more, so these thresholds are evidence, not proof.
